thread:
Alex W: Heads-up — I'm seeing a small but persistent fraction of /v1/generate requests routed to fallback-model even when the header-based matcher claims a match. header: X-Model-Pref present, prioritizer says match=true but runtime ends up on fallback. Anyone seen this?
Maria G: Did you check decision log sampling? We cut eval sampling down to 5% in the cluster last week to reduce noise — could be missing the exact traces.
Jonathan S: Pulled one trace: decision_log_id=dlg_1790004000_42. The rule evaluation shows: matcher -> header.override (true) -> capacity_check (fail) -> fallback. capacity-check logs show `pool_capacity: 0` around that timestamp.
Alex W: That's odd — console policy shows header override applied before capacity fallback in the human UI, but runtime ordering seems to let capacity preempt header. Is ordering persisted in config or computed at runtime?
Maria G: Quick look at prioritizer code suggests ordering is: capacity check early to avoid enqueuing when fully exhausted. But we intentionally allowed header overrides to take precedence historically. Could be an old patch.
Jonathan S: ops-bot: created trace: trace_1790004000_1 for the sampled request and attached the decision log. decision_path logged as: `['matcher:priority','header:override','capacity:check','fallback']` which matches the observed behavior.
ops-bot: trace created: https://console.internal/traces/trace_1790004000_1 decision_log_id=dlg_1790004000_42
deploy-bot: rollout started for config patch `routing-sampling-1790004000` ✅
Alex W: Can we bump route-eval sampling to 50% for the next 30 minutes and run a focused synthetic that sends X-Model-Pref: "mistral-xxl" while we also simulate pool pressure? I want to repro the ordering deterministically.
Maria G: I can flip sampling — where is the sampling config now? env `ROUTE_DECISION_SAMPLING` in platform-configs or per-cluster override? Also will ensure traces are tagged with `route_version`.
Jonathan S: It's a per-tenant override in k8s ConfigMap `redwood-routing-config` under `sampling.rate` for `route_evals`. Patch I'm proposing: ```yaml
route_evals:
  sampling:
    rate: 0.5
    duration_seconds: 1800
    tag: route_v2_debug
```
Alex W: sgtm. After bump, run the synthetic and also attempt a controlled pool-saturate (scale down capacity) to force capacity-check path. If we reproduce, we can decide whether to change prioritizer ordering or make capacity a "soft" check that queues when queue_depth < N.
Maria G: Scheduling now. I'll also add a temporary dashboard panel: `decision_path_counts` + `capacity_failures_per_minute` so we can watch in real time.
Jonathan S: If reproduced, I propose we modify prioritizer to prefer header override when `match.confidence > 0.8` and treat `capacity_check` as soft when request is queueable. Filing RFC: https://go.internal/rfcs/PRIORITIZER-212 and will attach traces.
Alex W: Thanks — keep updates here. If anyone spots an increase in 503s or latency, ping #eng-oncall immediately.
Maria G: noted. flipping sampling now, will post when done. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: sampling config updated `routing-sampling-1790004000` -> rate=0.5 (applied to cluster-prod-a).
Maria G: applied, running synthetic run in 2 min. will report results.
Jonathan S: adding a short script for reproducer: ```bash
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -H "X-Model-Pref: mistral-xxl" https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate > /dev/null &
done
```
Alex W: perfect. thanks everyone.
